description: Check whether an AI decision is allowed, denied, or needs escalation according to a sealed NOMOS governance artifact. Always returns `allowed` (boolean) — that field is safe to read regardless of which artifact type answered. The rest of the shape genuinely differs by artifact type, because it proxies two different underlying endpoints: pub_ demo artifacts return a flat shape (`outcome`: auto_approved/auto_rejected/escalated, `rule_applied`, `rule_reference`, flat `confidence` and `audit_hash`); your own sealed artifacts from Studio return a nested shape (`verdict`: approved/rejected/escalated, a nested `rule` object, and nested `confidence`/`audit`/`performance` objects). See outputSchema for both exact shapes — do not assume one without checking which kind of artifact_id was passed. Use artifact IDs starting with pub_ for public demo artifacts that require no API key: pub_lending_v1 (loan approval), pub_refund_v1 (refund policy), pub_fraud_v1 (fraud detection), pub_hr_leave_v1 (HR leave approval), pub_kyc_v1 (KYC/identity).

api_key.description: NOMOS API key (nmk_live_...). Not required for pub_ artifacts.

artifact_id.description: Sealed artifact ID to evaluate against. Use pub_lending_v1, pub_refund_v1, pub_fraud_v1, pub_hr_leave_v1, or pub_kyc_v1 for public demos. Use your own artifact ID from Studio for custom governance.

decision.description: The action or decision being checked, as a verb phrase (e.g. "approve_loan", "process_refund", "approve_leave"). Should match an action defined in the artifact.

domain_id.description: Your NOMOS domain ID. Required for custom artifacts created in Studio. Not needed for pub_ artifacts.

inputs.description: Key/value input fields for rule evaluation (e.g. {"amount": 5000, "credit_score": 720}). Fields must match the artifact's declared data contract.

name: verify_decision

anyOf.description: Shape returned for pub_ demo artifacts (via /api/v1/verify).
Shape returned for your own sealed artifacts from Studio (via /api/v1/verify-decision).

confidence.description: Nested for this shape, not a flat number.

rule.description: Present only when a rule matched.
